title: GistUI abstract tree, JSON form
description: The tree a processor produces, as the conformance suite writes it (GistUI Format 1.0, section 13.5). The value is the root node, or null when the program has no root.

type.description: A component name of the catalog, or a special type.

id.description: Node id (section 13.3). Optional in the JSON form.

props.description: Static prop values. Left out when empty.

dyn.description: Runtime expressions by prop name, in canonical text form (Appendix B). For an #expr node the key is "value".

children.description: Child nodes in order. Left out when empty.

partial.description: True while the owning statement is still open. Never true in a final tree.

expected.description: On #pending: the component type expected in this place.

value.description: A prop value: JSON data, a table, or a node (a component passed as a prop).

table.description: A table value in short form: column names with their type (:n number, :s string) and the typed rows. The full model is {columns, rows, text} (section 12.4).
